prompt: Write make_manifest.py in the repository root. Running `python make_manifest.py` must walk every file under dist/ and write manifest.txt in the repository root, one line per file, listing the file's sha256. Nothing may run when the module is merely imported.
fact_terms: uppercase hex behind a SHA256: prefix
sorted by path with an entries count on the last line
every artifact we hand to a partner

synthesis.why: One session carries the rule's content and a later one carries its scope. The earlier session defines the manifest format for the nightly export and says nothing about release bundles; the later session widens that format to every partner artifact and never restates it. Either session alone leaves the fixture's old release format looking correct.

shards.role: the format, scoped at the time to the nightly export
